response.rationale: A is the beehive, looked up by its id (InspectionRepository.findByHive(hiveId)). B is a weighing device: ScaleService returns a ScaleRecord and calls ScaleRepository.findBySerial and WeightReadingRepository, so the scale has its own serial number and weight readings. ScaleService also calls HiveRepository.findById and ScaleRepository.findByHive, so a scale is linked to a hive. That link does not make them the same concept.
